cycle_summaries.mathematical_learning: Cycle 5 converts the padding quarantine into a general projection-carrier dichotomy. The valid bridge says N^{1+epsilon} lower bounds transfer through ell(N) only when ell(N)^c is below the threshold. Positive polynomial embedding length gives only a bounded exponent window; subpolynomial embedding length gives all exponents but turns the source lower bound into ell(N)^{omega(1)}. Thus pure projection magnification fails as a weak-source path, with an explicit falsifier rather than a slogan.
